verdict.rationale: The IRS documents real system-to-system machine channels: MeF (XML transmission) and the IRIS Application-to-Application intake for information returns. These are not public APIs, though. Access requires becoming an Authorized e-file Provider (up to 45 days, fingerprinting for some principals) or obtaining a Transmitter Control Code. Probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, and online account services sit behind an ID.me biometric check. Missing for 10: an openly accessible public API, coverage beyond filing (EIN, payments, account, forms), published OpenAPI/machine-readable docs, and agent-usable auth without credentialing or biometric gates.
